angle: The only reel about the stock itself: one live grid of towers, floors and units, where booking a flat locks it and the price is read off the unit instead of a forwarded list.

hook.question: So which price is the real one?

scenes.vo: Every tower, floor and unit sits in one grid, each with its own price.
Book a unit and it locks, so a second agent cannot sell it.

chip.title: Sold once, only once
chip.sub: Booked units drop out of the form

scenes.vo: Each booking runs from Token to Agreement to Registered, with milestones attached.
The dashboard counts the same units, so nobody retypes a number.
Reports show units left and booking value for every project you sell.
scenes.focus: the Units Left column in the Projects table

cta.note: EstateCRM. Built for Indian real estate.
